vulnerabilities.description: Auth0 token obtained via getAccessTokenSilently() but never included in fetch request headers. Token is discarded, making the API call unauthenticated. Attacker can upload files without valid authentication.
Auth0 token obtained but never used in fetch request for document generation. API calls are made without authentication tokens.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add Authorization header to all authenticated requests

vulnerabilities.description: Auth0 token obtained but never added to request headers. Multiple instances throughout component where token is discarded.
vulnerabilities.code: if (isAuthenticated) { const token = await getAccessTokenSilently(); } // token never used
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add token to Authorization headers in all fetch requests

vulnerabilities.description: Client-side payment bypass flag: skipPayment: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' sent to API. Attacker can modify environment variable or intercept to bypass payment requirements.
vulnerabilities.remediation: NEVER send payment bypass flags from client. Enforce payment logic entirely server-side based on user account status.

vulnerabilities.description: Dynamic require via eval() to load template modules. While commented as necessary for Webpack bypass, this creates security risk if template names are user-controlled.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Consider using dynamic import() or require.resolve() with strict whitelist validation

vulnerabilities.description: ReactMarkdown renders user-controlled TOS content. While React provides escaping, malicious Markdown could contain scripts or unsafe HTML if combined with custom renderers.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use sanitize-html library or ensure reactmarkdown config has allowHtml: false

vulnerabilities.description: File type validation relies only on MIME type header which can be easily spoofed. No actual file content validation (magic byte checking).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement server-side magic byte verification in /api/evidence/upload for PDF/JPG/PNG

vulnerabilities.description: Token obtained but not used in validation API request
vulnerabilities.code: const token = await getAccessTokenSilently(); // Never used
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add Authorization header to fetch request

vulnerabilities.description: Token obtained for fact rewrite request but not included in headers
vulnerabilities.code: const token = await getAccessTokenSilently(); // Not added to headers

vulnerabilities.description: Token obtained for payment intent creation but not used in API request
vulnerabilities.code: const token = await getAccessTokenSilently(); // Not added to request

vulnerabilities.description: Personal information (names, addresses, case details) stored in unencrypted React state. Could be exposed in browser memory or dev tools.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Consider encrypting sensitive fields or implementing field-level access controls server-side

vulnerabilities.description: userName prop passed to component and rendered in JSX without sanitization. While React escapes by default, could be vulnerable to edge cases.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use a sanitization library like DOMPurify or ensure names are validated server-side

vulnerabilities.description: User-provided affiantName directly interpolated into AI prompt without escaping. Could allow prompt injection attacks.
vulnerabilities.code: `You went to the store instead of "${affiantName} went to the store"`
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use templated prompts or sanitize/escape user inputs before LLM calls

vulnerabilities.description: affiantName sanitized only for spaces/special chars but not for path traversal. File name could potentially contain ../ sequences.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use stricter regex: replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') and reject names starting with '.'

vulnerabilities.description: Error details sent to window.logError without sanitization. Could expose system paths or sensitive information in production.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Filter error messages before sending; only log sanitized error codes

vulnerabilities.description: API response fields accessed directly without type validation or sanitization before use
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate response structure with Zod before using fields

vulnerabilities.description: API_BASE_URL set to empty string for relative URLs. Could be vulnerable to CNAME-based attacks if DNS is misconfigured.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Consider enforcing absolute URLs with domain validation

vulnerabilities.description: Fetch to /api/templates/states has no explicit CORS handling shown. Fallback to hardcoded list could expose default states.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Ensure CORS headers are properly set server-side

vulnerabilities.description: Validation messages and suggestions from API rendered directly without escaping
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate API response structure and escape HTML in strings

recommendations.title: Fix Authentication Token Usage
recommendations.description: CRITICAL: Multiple API calls (evidence upload, document generation, chat, validation, payment) obtain Auth0 tokens but never use them. This completely breaks authentication on these endpoints.
recommendations.action: Add Authorization headers with Bearer tokens to all authenticated fetch requests

recommendations.title: Remove Client-Side Payment Bypass
recommendations.description: CRITICAL: skipPayment flag in GenerateButton allows bypassing payment logic if environment variable is controlled by attacker.
recommendations.action: Remove skipPayment from client code entirely. Enforce all payment logic server-side only based on user subscription status from database

recommendations.title: Implement Server-Side File Validation
recommendations.description: File upload validation relies on client-side MIME type checking which is easily spoofed. No magic byte verification exists.
recommendations.action: Implement magic byte/file signature verification in upload endpoint for PDF, JPG, PNG

recommendations.title: Sanitize Markdown Rendering
recommendations.description: ReactMarkdown renders TOS content without explicit sanitization configuration. Could allow unsafe HTML/script injection.
recommendations.action: Install sanitize-html and sanitize Markdown output before rendering

recommendations.title: Validate All API Responses
recommendations.description: API responses are used directly without schema validation. No protection against server returning malicious data.
affectedFiles: Multiple - all components making API calls
recommendations.action: Use Zod or io-ts to validate all API response structures before accessing properties

recommendations.title: Protect Sensitive User Input
recommendations.description: Personal information (names, addresses) stored in client state without encryption. Could be exposed in dev tools or memory dumps.
recommendations.action: Minimize PII storage in client state. Fetch from secure server context when needed.

recommendations.title: Sanitize AI Prompt Inputs
recommendations.description: User-provided data (affiantName, facts) interpolated directly into LLM prompts without escaping. Could allow prompt injection.
recommendations.action: Use prompt templating libraries and sanitize all user inputs before LLM calls

recommendations.title: Audit eval() Usage
recommendations.description: TemplateLoader.js uses eval('require') for dynamic template loading. While necessary for Webpack bypass, restrict template names to whitelist.
recommendations.action: Implement strict whitelist of valid template names before dynamic require

recommendations.title: Implement Rate Limiting
recommendations.description: Client-side debouncing on validation requests but no server-side rate limiting visible. Could enable DoS attacks.
recommendations.action: Implement server-side rate limiting in lib/api/rateLimit.ts for all user-facing endpoints

recommendations.title: Audit Error Logging
recommendations.description: Error details sent to monitoring without sanitization. Could expose system paths, stack traces, or sensitive data.
recommendations.action: Filter error messages and only log non-sensitive error codes and types

checklist.sqlInjection: PASS - Using parameterized queries via pg.Pool in lib/db.ts

checklist.dataEncryption: FAIL - PII stored in plaintext client state
